authorization: User requested implementation of all previously proposed gameplay smoothness optimizations.

characterization.method: Call actual timed OrbitController and LinearController factories with identical inputs and 30/60/120/144 update counts per second. Isolated circular track removes geometric speed modulation; no global clocks or runtime code altered. This is source characterization, not a browser refresh-rate measurement.

hardwareMeasurement.method: Optimized source game, actual mouse/keyboard, Chrome/Edge hardware WebGL, 1440x900 DPR2, GPU timer queries disabled. Real aim direction changes and Alt-drag spin tip changes supplement walking and shooting. No clock, RAF or WebGL replacement. Input latency is event-to-observed-render, not display latency.

hardwareMeasurement.interpretation: Same query-free input script, viewport and native DPR 2 on this GPU. Walking trims first 500 ms and frames after key-up. Source-level rate characterization is not a high-refresh display measurement. Camera angles and shot trajectories are not pixel-matched between versions. Short Practice scenarios; interval includes render scheduling, not presented display latency.

limitations: Measurements apply to this Intel GPU and Chrome/Edge versions, with a 60 Hz schedule.
No subjective ghosting assessment or real 120/144 Hz display certification.
Finite continuous sessions are not complete-match or hours-long endurance certification.

priorFailedAttempt.cause: First modal blocking was originally deferred until the next UI update; fixed by a zero-time UI commit and rerun all eight hardware scenarios.
